about: N64 North American library for ROM Tools. Key: game ID (category letter + 2-letter ID). Box art: Kondorito (EmuMovies).

CFZ.title: F-Zero X
CFZ.description: Blisteringly fast futuristic racer supporting 30 vehicles on screen, complete with loops, jumps, and aggressive combat. Its speed, track design, and multiplayer made it a technical showcase and a fan favorite.

CLB.title: Mario Party
CLB.description: Party game that combined a virtual board game with dozens of short, chaotic multiplayer minigames. Collecting stars and coins through both luck and skill made it a multiplayer staple.

CZL.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
CZL.art: Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (USA) (Rev B).webp
CZL.description: Landmark 3D action-adventure in which Link explored Hyrule, solved dungeons, played magical ocarina melodies, used Z-targeting for combat, and battled Ganondorf across two time periods. Its epic scope, innovative controls, and emotional story made it one of the most acclaimed games of all time.

N22.title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing: Round 2
N22.description: Sequel that expanded the roster and refined the arcade boxing formula.

N2M.title: Madden NFL 2002
N2M.description: Final Madden release on the system, bringing late-series improvements to the aging hardware.

N2P.title: Rampage 2: Universal Tour
N2P.description: Sequel that added more monsters, cities, and cooperative destruction.

N2V.title: Chameleon Twist 2
N2V.description: Sequel that refined the tongue-based platforming and added new levels and abilities.

N32.title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
N32.description: Sequel expanding the plastic-soldier action with more missions, weapons, and the same tongue-in-cheek toy warfare.

N3H.title: International Track & Field 2000
N3H.description: Multi-event Olympic-style sports game built around precise button-timing challenges across various disciplines.

N3P.title: Triple Play 2000
N3P.description: Baseball game offering season play and a more arcade-oriented style.

N3T.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3
N3T.description: Further refined the formula with even smoother trick chaining, varied levels, and local multiplayer. It served as the final major N64 release.

N7I.title: FIFA Soccer 64
N7I.description: Early N64 FIFA entry that brought the series’ accessible soccer gameplay to the system.

N8I.title: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
N8I.description: Soccer title centered on qualifying for and competing in the World Cup, with a large selection of national teams.

N8M.title: Madden Football 64
N8M.description: American football game offering team selection, passing, running, tackling, and season modes in the early Madden N64 style.

N8W.title: World Cup 98
N8W.description: Soccer game focused on the 1998 FIFA World Cup, featuring national teams and tournament play.

N9B.title: NBA Live 99
N9B.description: More simulation-oriented basketball with deeper season modes and realistic play.

N9C.title: NASCAR '99
N9C.description: Stock-car racing featuring NASCAR teams and tracks with an emphasis on drafting and oval racing.

N9F.title: FIFA 99
N9F.description: Soccer game featuring national and club teams, fluid passing and shooting, and solid tournament modes.

N9H.title: NHL 99
N9H.description: Ice hockey game featuring NHL teams, solid skating and checking mechanics, and season modes.

N9M.title: Madden NFL 99
N9M.description: Updated Madden entry with improved rosters and features while retaining the series’ simulation focus.

NAC.title: Army Men: Air Combat
NAC.description: Helicopter combat game in which you command plastic Army Men units from the sky. Mission-based gameplay and the toy-soldier aesthetic defined the experience.

NAD.title: Worms Armageddon
NAD.description: Turn-based artillery strategy game in which teams of cartoon worms used an outrageous arsenal of weapons to eliminate opponents across destructible landscapes. Its humor, weapon variety, and multiplayer longevity made it a classic.

NAG.title: AeroGauge
NAG.description: Futuristic anti-gravity racer featuring experimental machines on high-speed tracks packed with sharp turns and boost pads. The floaty yet aggressive handling and sense of velocity made it a cult favorite among fans of F-Zero-style racing.

NAH.title: Asteroids Hyper 64
NAH.description: 3D reimagining of the classic Atari game. Players pilot a ship, destroy asteroids, and battle enemies in arena-style space combat that modernized the pure arcade formula.

NAI.title: Midway's Greatest Arcade Hits: Volume 1
NAI.description: Compilation of classic Midway arcade games, preserving several landmarks of arcade history.

NAL.title: Super Smash Bros.
NAL.description: Four-player crossover fighting game in which Nintendo characters battled on themed stages using attacks and items to knock opponents out of bounds. Its accessibility, character variety, and chaotic multiplayer made it an instant classic and the start of a major franchise.

NAM.title: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes
NAM.description: Third-person action game starring Sarge and his plastic Army Men squad. Players fought across toy-scale battlefields using weapons and vehicles in a lighthearted war setting that became a recognizable N64 brand.

NAR.title: Armorines: Project S.W.A.R.M.
NAR.description: First-person shooter in which elite soldiers fight waves of insectoid aliens. Heavy weapons, vehicle sections, and co-op play gave it a squad-based, military-action flavor.

NAS.title: All-Star Baseball 2001
NAS.description: Continued the series with updated rosters, refined batting and pitching mechanics, and the same emphasis on realistic baseball simulation.

NAY.title: Aidyn Chronicles: The First Mage
NAY.description: Traditional fantasy RPG in which you create and guide a party led by the young mage Aidyn. Turn-based battles, exploration of a large kingdom, character development, and a lengthy story gave it a classic Western RPG feel rare on the N64.

NB2.title: NBA In the Zone '99
NB2.description: Updated entry in the In the Zone series.

NB4.title: Bass Masters 2000
NB4.description: Dedicated bass-fishing simulation featuring multiple locations, equipment choices, and tournament-style challenges focused on technique and patience.

NB7.title: Banjo-Tooie
NB7.description: The ambitious sequel features larger, interconnected worlds, new moves, character transformations, and the ability to switch between Banjo and Kazooie for cooperative puzzles. It doubled down on exploration and collectathon depth.

NB9.title: NBA Jam 99
NB9.description: Arcade basketball continuing the over-the-top, two-on-two style of the original NBA Jam.

NBA.title: NBA In the Zone '98
NBA.description: Basketball title offering a mix of simulation and arcade styles with NBA teams.

NBC.title: Blast Corps
NBC.description: Rare’s unique action-puzzle game in which players pilot various vehicles to demolish buildings and clear a path for a runaway nuclear missile carrier. Creative destruction and inventive vehicle abilities made it memorable.

NBD.title: Bomberman Hero
NBD.description: Faster, more platform-oriented Bomberman adventure that sent the character across varied planets using bombs and acrobatic moves.

NBE.title: All-Star Baseball 2000
NBE.description: Baseball simulation featuring era-accurate MLB teams, detailed batting and pitching interfaces, and season or exhibition play. Acclaim’s series was known for its strong presentation and simulation depth.

NBF.title: Bio F.R.E.A.K.S.
NBF.description: One-on-one fighter featuring a roster of grotesque, distinctive combatants with special attacks and a dark, over-the-top aesthetic.

NBH.title: Body Harvest
NBH.description: Open-world action game in which a soldier travels through different historical eras to stop an alien invasion. Players used a wide variety of vehicles and weapons across large, destructible environments — an ambitious design that felt ahead of its time.

NBI.title: NFL Blitz 2000
NBI.description: Updated version of the arcade football series with more teams and modes.

NBK.title: Banjo-Kazooie
NBK.description: Rare’s colorful 3D collectathon starring the bear Banjo and his bird companion Kazooie. Players explore richly themed worlds, collect musical notes and jiggies, learn new moves, and work to rescue Banjo’s sister Tooty from the witch Gruntilda. Its charm, level design, and move-based progression made it one of the defining platformers of the generation.

NBL.title: Buck Bumble
NBL.description: Third-person shooter in which players control a cyborg bumblebee fighting insect enemies with an arsenal of weapons. The unusual premise and fluid aerial combat gave it personality.

NBM.title: Bomberman 64
NBM.description: 3D action-puzzle adventure in which Bomberman places bombs to defeat enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and explore themed stages. The classic bomb mechanics translated well into three dimensions.

NBO.title: Bottom of the 9th
NBO.description: Baseball game focused on pitching duels, clutch hitting, and the drama of late innings.

NBP.title: Blues Brothers 2000
NBP.description: Licensed platformer following the Blues Brothers through music-themed levels with combat and light puzzle elements.

NBQ.title: BattleTanx: Global Assault
NBQ.description: Sequel that expanded the tank combat with more arenas, weapons, and a broader global conflict storyline.

NBR.title: Milo's Astro Lanes
NBR.description: Futuristic bowling game that added power-ups and sci-fi flair to the classic sport.

NBS.title: All-Star Baseball 99
NBS.description: Early entry in Acclaim’s well-regarded baseball series, offering solid batting, pitching, fielding, and season modes with authentic teams of the era.

NBU.title: Bust-A-Move 2: Arcade Edition
NBU.description: Classic puzzle game in which players launch colored bubbles to make matches of three or more. Fast decision-making and competitive multiplayer kept it addictive.

NBV.title: Bomberman 64: The Second Attack!
NBV.description: Story-driven sequel that added more adventure and light RPG structure while retaining bomb-based combat and puzzle-solving.

NBW.title: Super Bowling
NBW.description: Bowling game offering multiple modes and solid multiplayer support.

NBX.title: BattleTanx
NBX.description: Vehicular combat game in which players command tanks in a post-apocalyptic setting. Arena battles, weapon pickups, and multiplayer destruction were the main draws.

NBY.title: A Bug's Life
NBY.description: 3D platformer based on the Pixar film in which you play as Flik. Explore oversized insect environments, use different abilities, and battle Hopper’s grasshopper army. It delivered colorful levels and straightforward collect-and-platform gameplay aimed at younger players.

NBZ.title: NFL Blitz
NBZ.description: Over-the-top arcade football that stripped away complex rules in favor of aggressive, fast-paced action and big hits. Its multiplayer was legendary for chaos.

NC2.title: ClayFighter: Sculptor's Cut
NC2.description: Enhanced version of ClayFighter 63⅓ that added extra fighters and content, becoming a sought-after rarity.

NCB.title: Charlie Blast's Territory
NCB.description: Puzzle-action game in which players use bombs to clear paths and destroy obstacles in a construction-themed setting.

NCC.title: Command & Conquer
NCC.description: Real-time strategy game in which players gather resources, build bases, and command GDI or Nod armies. It successfully brought the PC classic to consoles.

NCD.title: Carmageddon 64
NCD.description: Vehicular combat racer that rewarded players for running over pedestrians and destroying rival cars. Its dark humor and chaotic action made it notorious.

NCE.title: Nuclear Strike 64
NCE.description: Helicopter combat game featuring mission-based gameplay and a variety of weapons and vehicles.

NCF.title: ClayFighter 63⅓
NCF.description: One-on-one fighter with claymation-style characters, outrageous special moves, and a humorous tone that set it apart from more serious fighters.

NCH.title: Chopper Attack
NCH.description: Helicopter combat game featuring mission-based gameplay, enemy forces, and vehicle action.

NCK.title: NBA Courtside 2 Featuring Kobe Bryant
NCK.description: Basketball game starring Kobe Bryant with improved features over the original Courtside.

NCL.title: California Speed
NCL.description: Arcade racer set on California tracks with traffic, power-ups, and a light, accessible feel.

NCO.title: Jeremy McGrath Supercross 2000
NCO.description: Supercross motorcycle racing featuring realistic tracks and career progression centered on the famous rider.

NCR.title: Penny Racers
NCR.description: Racing game featuring customizable mini cars on colorful tracks.

NCS.title: S.C.A.R.S.
NCS.description: Futuristic racing game featuring animal-inspired vehicles, weapons, and combat-focused races.

NCT.title: Chameleon Twist
NCT.description: Platformer in which players control a cartoon chameleon that uses its long tongue to swing, eat enemies, and solve puzzles. The tongue mechanics were the star of the show.

NCU.title: Cruis'n USA
NCU.description: Arcade racer that took players across recognizable American landmarks with simple controls and exaggerated high-speed driving. Its pick-up-and-play nature made it a popular multiplayer choice.

NCW.title: Cruis'n World
NCW.description: Follow-up that expanded the formula with international landmarks, more stunts, and the same easy-to-learn racing.

NCY.title: South Park: Chef's Luv Shack
NCY.description: Party game starring South Park characters with a variety of minigames and humor from the show.

ND3.title: Castlevania
ND3.description: 3D action-adventure starring a whip-wielding protagonist exploring gothic environments, fighting classic Castlevania monsters, and solving light puzzles. It brought the series into polygonal 3D with mixed but memorable results.

ND4.title: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness
ND4.description: Expanded Castlevania adventure offering multiple playable characters, larger environments, and more of the series’ signature atmosphere and combat.

NDE.title: Destruction Derby 64
NDE.description: Vehicular combat focused on high-speed collisions, arena destruction, and surviving aggressive opponents.

NDH.title: Dual Heroes
NDH.description: Fighting game that allowed players to create and customize their own fighters in addition to the standard roster.

NDK.title: Dark Rift
NDK.description: One-on-one fighting game with a roster of unique characters and special attacks in a dark fantasy setting.

NDM.title: Doom 64
NDM.description: Console-exclusive Doom episode with a darker, more atmospheric presentation, new levels, and demon-filled environments. It is often praised as one of the best console Doom experiences.

NDN.title: Duke Nukem 64
NDN.description: Console version of Duke Nukem 3D featuring the wise-cracking protagonist, run-and-gun shooting, and multiplayer. It adapted the PC classic for N64 hardware with some unique levels.

NDO.title: Donkey Kong 64
NDO.description: Massive 3D collectathon featuring five playable Kongs (Donkey, Diddy, Lanky, Tiny, and Chunky), each with unique abilities. Players explored large worlds collecting bananas, golden bananas, and other items to stop King K. Rool. Its scale and variety were impressive even if the backtracking became divisive.

NDQ.title: Donald Duck: Quack Attack / Goin' Quackers
NDQ.description: Platform adventure starring Donald Duck through colorful, themed stages filled with obstacles and enemies.

NDT.title: South Park
NDT.description: Comedy game based on the animated series, featuring its irreverent characters and a mix of action and exploration in South Park settings.

NDU.title: Duck Dodgers Starring Daffy Duck
NDU.description: Platform adventure based on the Looney Tunes character, sending Daffy through space-themed levels.

NDW.title: Daikatana
NDW.description: First-person shooter/adventure designed by John Romero in which players travel through different time periods with sidekicks. Ambitious in scope but troubled in execution.

NDY.title: Diddy Kong Racing
NDY.description: Rare’s kart racer starring Diddy Kong and a memorable cast that included cars, hovercraft, and planes. Its adventure mode, boss races, and excellent multiplayer made it a strong competitor to Mario Kart 64.

NDZ.title: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour
NDZ.description: Third-person action game in which Duke travels through time to stop alien threats, mixing shooting and light platforming.

NEA.title: PGA European Tour Golf
NEA.description: Golf simulation focused on European courses, realistic club selection, wind, and tournament play.

NEG.title: Extreme-G
NEG.description: Futuristic anti-gravity bike racer with weapons, boost, and high-speed tracks that delivered intense, combat-filled races.

NEL.title: Elmo's Letter Adventure
NEL.description: Educational title that teaches letters through simple activities starring Elmo and other Sesame Street characters.

NEN.title: Elmo's Number Journey
NEN.description: Educational counterpart focused on numbers and counting with the same accessible Sesame Street presentation.

NEP.title: Star Wars Episode I: Racer
NEP.description: High-speed podracing game featuring a large roster of racers, upgradeable engines, hazardous tracks, and intense acceleration-based competition. It captured the thrill of the movie’s podrace sequence.

NER.title: Aero Fighters Assault
NER.description: 3D aerial combat shooter with selectable pilots and distinctive aircraft. Dogfights, mission objectives, and over-the-top weapons defined the experience. It brought the classic Aero Fighters spirit into full 3D with a strong arcade feel.

NET.title: Quest 64
NET.description: Fantasy RPG in which the young mage Brian explored a magical world, learned elemental spells, and battled enemies in real time. It was one of the earlier Western-style RPGs on the system.

NF9.title: Fox Sports College Hoops '99
NF9.description: College basketball game with authentic teams and a mix of simulation and arcade styles.

NFB.title: NFL Blitz 2001
NFB.description: Further Blitz entry that continued the over-the-top style.

NFD.title: Flying Dragon
NFD.description: Fighting game that mixed traditional versus battles with light RPG progression elements.

NFF.title: Fighting Force 64
NFF.description: Cooperative beat-’em-up in which players fought through urban environments against waves of enemies.

NFG.title: Fighter Destiny 2
NFG.description: One-on-one fighter with a large roster and the series’ distinctive point-based scoring system for moves.

NFH.title: In-Fisherman Bass Hunter 64
NFH.description: Fishing simulation focused on realistic bass fishing with detailed locations, equipment, and technique.

NFL.title: Madden NFL 2001
NFL.description: Further refinement of the Madden formula on N64 hardware.

NFO.title: Forsaken 64
NFO.description: First-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world, featuring hoverbike sections and arena-style combat.

NFQ.title: Razor Freestyle Scooter
NFQ.description: Extreme sports game focused on scooter tricks, combinations, and competitive events.

NFU.title: Conker's Bad Fur Day
NFU.description: Rare’s deliberately crude, adult-oriented 3D platform adventure starring the squirrel Conker. It mixed dark comedy, movie parodies, varied gameplay set pieces, and impressive technical presentation. Its irreverent humor and production values made it a cult classic.

NFW.title: F-1 World Grand Prix
NFW.description: Formula One racing simulation featuring real tracks, teams, and championship modes with a strong emphasis on realistic handling.

NFX.title: Star Fox 64
NFX.description: Rail-shooting space adventure starring Fox McCloud and his team. Branching routes, aerial dogfights, memorable bosses, All-Range Mode, and excellent multiplayer battles made it a standout. The voice acting and cinematic presentation were especially impressive for the time.

NG2.title: Extreme-G 2
NG2.description: Sequel that refined the formula with more tracks, weapons, and even greater speed.

NG5.title: Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon
NG5.description: Quirky Japanese action-adventure featuring the thief Goemon and his allies. Exploration, platforming, combat, and humorous set pieces gave it a distinctive personality.

NGA.title: G.A.S.P!! Fighters' NEXTream
NGA.description: One-on-one fighter featuring a roster of distinctive combatants and special attacks.

NGB.title: Top Gear Hyper-Bike
NGB.description: Motorcycle racing featuring multiple bikes and tracks with a focus on speed and handling.

NGC.title: GT 64: Championship Edition
NGC.description: Racing game focused on licensed-style cars, tracks, and championship progression.

NGE.title: GoldenEye 007
NGE.description: Landmark first-person shooter based on the James Bond film. Players controlled Bond through objective-based missions that emphasized stealth and gadgets as much as shooting. Its four-player split-screen multiplayer became legendary and helped define console multiplayer for years.

NGN.title: Golden Nugget 64
NGN.description: Casino collection offering poker, blackjack, roulette, and other table games in a digital casino setting.

NGR.title: Top Gear Rally
NGR.description: Rally racing with dirt tracks, car tuning, weather effects, and demanding off-road handling that rewarded precision.

NGV.title: Glover
NGV.description: Platformer in which players control a magic glove that manipulates a rubber ball through puzzle-platform levels. The ball physics and creative level design were its defining features.

NGX.title: Gauntlet Legends
NGX.description: Cooperative fantasy hack-and-slash in which up to four players battled hordes of monsters, collected treasure, and upgraded their heroes. The classic Gauntlet formula thrived in multiplayer.

NH5.title: Nagano Winter Olympics '98
NH5.description: Multi-event winter sports game covering Olympic disciplines with button-timing challenges.

NH9.title: NHL Breakaway 99
NH9.description: Updated Breakaway entry with refined gameplay.

NHC.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
NHC.description: Licensed action-adventure based on the TV series, featuring combat and platforming as the hero Hercules.

NHG.title: F1 Pole Position 64
NHG.description: Formula One title offering licensed teams and tracks with a focus on competitive racing.

NHL.title: NHL Breakaway 98
NHL.description: Fast-paced ice hockey with strong multiplayer focus.

NHM.title: Mia Hamm Soccer 64
NHM.description: Soccer game featuring Mia Hamm and women’s national teams, bringing more representation to N64 sports titles.

NHN.title: Olympic Hockey '98
NHN.description: Ice hockey game centered on the Olympic tournament format.

NHO.title: NHL Blades of Steel '99
NHO.description: Ice hockey title offering a mix of arcade and simulation styles.

NHT.title: Hydro Thunder
NHT.description: Arcade powerboat racer known for massive jumps, turbulent water physics, shortcuts, and speed-boosting pickups. Its sense of speed and spectacle stood out.

NHV.title: Hybrid Heaven
NHV.description: Sci-fi action RPG that mixed third-person exploration and shooting with an unusual turn-based combat system focused on targeting specific body parts. Its strange blend of genres made it unique.

NHW.title: Hot Wheels Turbo Racing
NHW.description: Racing game featuring Hot Wheels cars on stunt-filled tracks that captured the toy line’s high-speed, gravity-defying spirit.

NHX.title: Hexen
NHX.description: Dark fantasy first-person action game offering multiple character classes, puzzle-heavy levels, and hordes of supernatural enemies. It expanded on the Doom formula with greater exploration.

NIC.title: Indy Racing 2000
NIC.description: Open-wheel racing focused on IndyCar-style ovals and road courses.

NIJ.title: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine
NIJ.art: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine (USA).webp
NIJ.description: Action-adventure in which players control Indiana Jones through ruins filled with puzzles, platforming, and combat. It aimed for a Tomb Raider-style experience with Indy’s signature personality.

NIS.title: International Superstar Soccer 2000
NIS.description: Soccer game continuing Konami’s highly regarded ISS series with strong AI, fluid controls, and excellent multiplayer.

NIV.title: Space Invaders
NIV.description: Modernized version of the classic arcade shooter, tasking players with clearing descending alien formations with updated visuals and mechanics.

NJA.title: NBA Jam 2000
NJA.description: Sequel that kept the fast, exaggerated arcade basketball formula alive.

NJF.title: Jet Force Gemini
NJF.description: Rare’s ambitious sci-fi action-adventure shooter in which players controlled a team of heroes fighting an insectoid army, exploring large levels, and rescuing endangered Tribals. Its scale, weapon variety, and co-op options were impressive.

NJM.title: Earthworm Jim 3D
NJM.description: Platform adventure continuing the surreal adventures of the worm in a robotic suit, complete with quirky levels and weapons.

NJO.title: Jeopardy!
NJO.description: Digital version of the classic quiz show with solo and multiplayer modes.

NJP.title: International Superstar Soccer 64
NJP.description: One of the best soccer games on the system, praised for its responsive controls, intelligent AI, and addictive multiplayer matches.

NJQ.title: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
NJQ.art: Batman Beyond - Return of the Joker (USA).webp
NJQ.description: Licensed action-adventure in which players control the future Batman (Terry McGinnis) through combat and platforming stages inspired by the animated series.

NK2.title: Snowboard Kids 2
NK2.description: Sequel that added new courses, characters, and refined the racing-and-combat blend.

NK4.title: Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards
NK4.description: Side-scrolling platformer in which Kirby inhales enemies and combines copy abilities to create powerful mixed powers while collecting crystal shards. The ability-combination system was a highlight.

NKA.title: Fighters Destiny
NKA.description: Fighting game known for its unique scoring system that rewarded a variety of moves rather than just damage.

NKE.title: Knife Edge: Nose Gunner
NKE.description: On-rails shooter in which players controlled a gunner fighting through futuristic combat missions.

NKG.title: Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Griffey Jr.
NKG.art: Major League Baseball featuring Ken Griffey Jr. (USA).webp
NKG.description: Baseball simulation starring Ken Griffey Jr. with season and exhibition play.

NKI.title: Killer Instinct Gold
NKI.description: Fast, combo-focused fighting game featuring a roster of distinctive characters, special moves, and cinematic finishing attacks. It brought the arcade experience home with strong presentation.

NKJ.title: Ken Griffey Jr.'s Slugfest
NKJ.description: Baseball game starring Ken Griffey Jr., offering solid batting and pitching mechanics along with season play.

NKK.title: Knockout Kings 2000
NKK.description: Boxing game featuring real fighters, career modes, and an emphasis on realistic punching and stamina management.

NKT.title: Mario Kart 64
NKT.description: The definitive four-player kart racer of the era, featuring Nintendo characters, item-based combat, memorable tracks, and excellent split-screen multiplayer that defined living-room competition.

NL2.title: Top Gear Rally 2
NL2.description: Sequel that expanded the car and course selection while retaining the challenging rally focus.

NLC.title: Automobili Lamborghini
NLC.description: Racing game centered on Lamborghini supercars. It offered a selection of courses and a straightforward arcade racing experience focused on speed and exotic machinery.

NLG.title: LEGO Racers
NLG.description: Racing game that let players build and race their own LEGO vehicles on colorful, themed tracks.

NLR.title: Lode Runner 3-D
NLR.description: 3D update of the classic puzzle-platformer in which players dug through levels, collected gold, and avoided enemies.

NM3.title: Monster Truck Madness 64
NM3.description: Off-road racing featuring monster trucks, destruction, and varied outdoor courses.

NM4.title: Mortal Kombat 4
NM4.description: One-on-one fighter continuing the series’ signature violence, fatalities, and large roster in 3D.

NM6.title: Mega Man 64 (Mega Man Legends)
NM6.description: 3D action-adventure starring Mega Man Volnutt (a different Mega Man) exploring a post-apocalyptic world of islands and ancient technology. It blended shooting, exploration, and RPG elements.

NM8.title: Mario Tennis
NM8.description: Colorful tennis game starring Nintendo characters with approachable controls that still rewarded skilled shot placement and positioning.

NMB.title: Mike Piazza's Strike Zone
NMB.description: Baseball game featuring Mike Piazza with a focus on batting and pitching mechanics.

NMD.title: Madden NFL 2000
NMD.description: Continued annual updates to rosters, presentation, and gameplay systems.

NME.title: Mace: The Dark Age
NME.description: One-on-one fighter featuring medieval weapons, a dark fantasy roster, and special attacks.

NMF.title: Mario Golf
NMF.description: Accessible yet surprisingly deep golf game starring Mario characters. Timing-based swing controls, multiple courses, and unlockables made it widely appealing.

NMI.title: Mission: Impossible
NMI.description: Action-adventure based on the film, featuring stealth, gadgets, and mission objectives in a 3D environment.

NMK.title: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
NMK.description: Compilation that brought together characters and stages from earlier Mortal Kombat games into one package.

NML.title: Mickey's Speedway USA
NML.description: Kart racer starring Mickey Mouse and Disney characters on tracks inspired by American locations.

NMO.title: Monopoly
NMO.description: Digital adaptation of the classic board game with the standard property-trading rules and multiplayer support.

NMQ.title: Paper Mario
NMQ.description: Story-rich RPG with distinctive paper-styled visuals. Players controlled Mario in turn-based battles that featured timed action commands, explored a charming version of the Mushroom Kingdom, and enjoyed a humorous script. It became one of the most beloved RPGs on the system.

NMR.title: MRC: Multi-Racing Championship
NMR.description: Racing game offering a selection of cars and tracks with championship progression.

NMT.title: Magical Tetris Challenge
NMT.description: Tetris variant featuring Disney characters and competitive puzzle modes that added magic and special blocks.

NMU.title: Big Mountain 2000
NMU.description: Snowboarding title focused on freestyle tricks, races, and mountain courses with a strong emphasis on aerial style.

NMV.title: Mario Party 3
NMV.description: Further evolution of the series with new boards, duel modes, and refined minigame variety.

NMW.title: Mario Party 2
NMW.description: Sequel that introduced themed boards, character costumes, and an even larger selection of competitive minigames.

NMX.title: Excitebike 64
NMX.description: Motocross racing game with realistic track deformation, big air stunts, multiple modes, and a robust course editor. The sense of speed and customization made it a favorite.

NMY.title: Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero
NMY.description: Side-scrolling action-adventure prequel focused on the origin of Sub-Zero, mixing platforming and combat.

NN2.title: NASCAR 2000
NN2.description: Updated NASCAR title with refined physics and presentation.

NN6.title: Dr. Mario 64
NN6.description: Falling-block puzzle game in which players match colored viruses with capsule halves. Competitive multiplayer modes added to its lasting appeal.

NNA.title: Star Wars Episode I: Battle for Naboo
NNA.art: Star Wars Episode I - Battle for Naboo (USA).webp
NNA.description: Flight and ground combat game set during the events of Episode I, featuring a mix of air and land missions.

NNB.title: Kobe Bryant in NBA Courtside
NNB.description: Basketball game featuring Kobe Bryant and NBA teams, offering a mix of arcade and simulation styles.

NNC.title: Nightmare Creatures
NNC.description: Survival-horror action game in which players fought Victorian-era monsters with melee combat.

NNL.title: NBA Live 2000
NNL.description: Updated NBA Live entry with improved presentation and features.

NNM.title: Namco Museum 64
NNM.description: Compilation of classic Namco arcade hits including Pac-Man, Galaga, and others.

NNS.title: Beetle Adventure Racing!
NNS.description: Distinctive arcade racer starring Volkswagen Beetles on huge, multi-path tracks filled with shortcuts, hidden routes, and environmental spectacle. Its sense of exploration and playful track design made it a standout.

NO7.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
NO7.description: First-person shooter based on the Bond film, featuring stealth and action missions with the series’ signature gadgets and objectives.

NOB.title: Ogre Battle 64: Person of Lordly Caliber
NOB.art: Ogre Battle 64 - Person of Lordly Caliber (USA).webp
NOB.description: Tactical strategy RPG in which players led an army through a political conflict, arranged units on a grid, and made choices that affected the story and ending. Its depth and strategic combat earned it a dedicated following.

NOF.title: Off Road Challenge
NOF.description: Off-road racing with trucks, dirt tracks, and a focus on aggressive driving.

NOH.title: Transformers: Beast Wars Transmetals
NOH.description: Fighting game based on the Beast Wars Transformers series, featuring transforming characters and special moves.

NOW.title: Brunswick Circuit Pro Bowling
NOW.description: Bowling simulation with realistic ball physics, multiple lane conditions, and strong multiplayer support.

NP3.title: Pokémon Stadium 2
NP3.description: Sequel that expanded the roster, added more battle formats and minigames, and supported the second-generation Game Boy games.

NP9.title: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness
NP9.description: 3D maze adventure starring Ms. Pac-Man that mixed classic maze-chase gameplay with puzzles and collectibles.

NPD.title: Perfect Dark
NPD.description: Rare’s spiritual successor to GoldenEye, starring agent Joanna Dark. It featured objective-driven missions, a wide array of gadgets, customizable bots, and extremely deep multiplayer options. Many consider its multiplayer the pinnacle of N64 multiplayer design.

NPF.title: Pokémon Snap
NPF.description: Rail-based photography game in which players rode through Pokémon habitats and photographed creatures behaving naturally or reacting to thrown items. Its unique concept and charm made it a favorite.

NPG.title: Hey You, Pikachu!
NPG.description: Voice-recognition adventure in which players interact with Pikachu using the N64 Microphone accessory. Building friendship through conversation and activities was the core appeal.

NPN.title: Pokémon Puzzle League
NPN.description: Fast-paced puzzle game based on matching colored panels, starring Pokémon characters and offering strong competitive play.

NPO.title: Pokémon Stadium
NPO.description: 3D Pokémon battle game featuring tournament cups, entertaining minigames, and the ability to transfer and battle real Game Boy Pokémon. It was a major event for Pokémon fans.

NPQ.title: The Powerpuff Girls: Chemical X-Traction
NPQ.description: Action game starring Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup as they fought villains using their unique powers.

NPR.title: South Park Rally
NPR.description: Racing game featuring South Park characters on tracks filled with the show’s signature style and humor.

NPU.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue
NPU.description: Action game based on the Power Rangers series with combat and mission-based stages.

NPW.title: Pilotwings 64
NPW.description: Flight and aerial-sports simulation in which players mastered hang gliders, gyrocopters, and rocket belts across scenic environments. Its sense of freedom and varied challenges made it a launch standout.

NPX.title: Polaris SnoCross
NPX.description: Snowmobile racing featuring tracks, tricks, and competitive modes.

NQ2.title: Quake II
NQ2.description: Sci-fi first-person shooter in which a lone soldier fought the hostile Strogg across alien installations using a powerful arsenal.

NQ8.title: NFL Quarterback Club 98
NQ8.description: Early N64 entry in the Quarterback Club series focused on football simulation.

NQ9.title: NFL Quarterback Club 99
NQ9.description: Updated version with roster and feature improvements.

NQB.title: NFL Quarterback Club 2000
NQB.description: Further entry that kept the series competitive with Madden.

NQC.title: NFL QB Club 2001
NQC.description: American football game with an emphasis on quarterback play and simulation elements.

NQK.title: Quake 64
NQK.description: Console adaptation of the dark first-person shooter, featuring maze-like levels, monsters, a strong arsenal, and multiplayer combat.

NR2.title: Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA
NR2.description: Arcade racer with stunt arenas, hidden shortcuts, and fast courses across American settings. Its sense of speed and exploration of tracks were highlights.

NR3.title: Stunt Racer 64
NR3.description: Racing game focused on stunts, varied tracks, and competitive events.

NR6.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
NR6.description: Tactical first-person shooter that emphasized careful planning, stealth, and realistic special-forces operations. One wrong move could end a mission, creating high tension.

NRC.title: Top Gear Overdrive
NRC.description: Racing game with a selection of cars, tracks, and championship modes.

NRD.title: Ready 2 Rumble Boxing
NRD.description: Arcade boxing game with colorful, over-the-top characters and exaggerated fights that emphasized entertainment over simulation.

NRE.title: Resident Evil 2
NRE.description: Survival-horror adventure following rookie cop Leon Kennedy and student Claire Redfield as they escaped a zombie outbreak in Raccoon City. Fixed camera angles, resource management, and tense atmosphere defined the experience.

NRG.title: Rugrats: Scavenger Hunt
NRG.description: Board-game style adventure starring the Rugrats characters with minigames and exploration.

NRI.title: The New Tetris
NRI.description: Tetris variant that introduced new modes and multiplayer options while retaining the classic falling-block gameplay.

NRK.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
NRK.description: Platform adventure based on the Rugrats film, featuring the babies in Paris-themed stages.

NRO.title: Road Rash 64
NRO.description: Motorcycle racing-combat game in which riders punched and struck rivals while racing on traffic-filled roads. The mix of racing and brawling remained addictive.

NRP.title: Rampage World Tour
NRP.description: Destructive arcade action in which players controlled giant monsters that smashed cities, ate people, and battled military forces. Cooperative play amplified the chaos.

NRR.title: Roadsters
NRR.description: Street-racing game with upgradeable cars and tournament-style progression.

NRS.title: Star Wars: Rogue Squadron
NRS.description: Flight-action game in which players piloted X-wings and other craft through missions inspired by the original trilogy. Its sense of being a Star Wars pilot and strong mission variety made it popular.

NRT.title: Rat Attack!
NRT.description: Puzzle game in which players herded and captured rats using various gadgets and tools.

NRU.title: San Francisco Rush 2049
NRU.description: Futuristic sequel that added high-speed city tracks, stunt arenas, and unlockable wings for aerial tricks.

NRV.title: Re-Volt
NRV.description: Radio-controlled car racer featuring imaginative toy-sized tracks, power-ups, and challenging time trials. Its track design and handling earned it a cult following.

NRW.title: Turok: Rage Wars
NRW.description: Multiplayer-focused arena shooter featuring Turok characters, varied weapons, and competitive combat modes.

NRX.title: Robotron 64
NRX.description: Twin-stick-style arcade shooter in which players blasted swarms of robots and rescued humans amid constant on-screen chaos. It captured the intensity of the original.

NRZ.title: Ridge Racer 64
NRZ.description: Arcade racing game focused on drift-heavy handling, fast circuits, and a strong selection of cars and modes. It successfully brought the Ridge Racer feel to the N64.

NS6.title: Star Soldier: Vanishing Earth
NS6.description: Vertical shooter featuring intense enemy waves, power-ups, and classic shoot-’em-up action.

NSB.title: Twisted Edge Extreme Snowboarding
NSB.description: Snowboarding racer that mixed racing with tricks and competitive modes.

NSC.title: Starshot: Space Circus Fever
NSC.description: Platform adventure with a circus theme, quirky characters, and lighthearted gameplay.

NSD.title: Shadow Man
NSD.description: Dark action-adventure in which the voodoo-powered hero Shadow Man explored both the Living World and the Deadside, using a mix of firearms and supernatural abilities. Its atmosphere was distinctive.

NSF.title: San Francisco Rush: Extreme Racing
NSF.description: Arcade racer known for its fast city circuits, numerous shortcuts, big jumps, and emphasis on finding the fastest lines.

NSG.title: Shadowgate 64: Trials of the Four Towers
NSG.art: Shadowgate 64 - Trials of the Four Towers (USA) (En,Es).webp
NSG.description: First-person adventure that continued the classic Shadowgate series with puzzle-solving and exploration in a fantasy setting.

NSK.title: Snowboard Kids
NSK.description: Cartoon-style snowboarding racer featuring item attacks, shortcuts, tricks, and strong multiplayer competition. Its playful personality set it apart.

NSL.title: Spider-Man
NSL.description: Action game in which players controlled Spider-Man through combat and web-slinging across mission-based levels. The web-swinging and variety of villains were highlights.

NSM.title: Super Mario 64
NSM.description: The pioneering 3D platformer in which Mario explored Princess Peach’s castle, collected Power Stars, and completed open-ended stages. Its analog-stick controls, camera system, and sense of freedom redefined platforming and became one of the most influential games ever made.

NSO.title: NBA Showtime: NBA on NBC
NSO.description: Arcade basketball that blended elements of Hangtime and NBA Jam with NBC branding.

NSP.title: Superman: The New Superman Adventures
NSP.description: Licensed action-adventure in which players controlled Superman through Metropolis-themed levels. Despite high expectations, it became infamous for technical issues and design problems.

NSQ.title: StarCraft 64
NSQ.description: Console adaptation of Blizzard’s real-time strategy classic, allowing players to command Terran, Zerg, or Protoss forces through the full campaign and multiplayer. It was an impressive technical achievement on the hardware.

NSU.title: Rocket: Robot on Wheels
NSU.description: Physics-driven 3D platformer in which a robot explored an amusement park, solving inventive puzzles with interactive machinery and gadgets. Its creativity and physics stood out.

NSV.title: Space Station Silicon Valley
NSV.description: Quirky 3D puzzle-platformer in which a robot took control of animal-shaped machines, each with different abilities, to solve inventive challenges. Its creativity and humor earned it a cult status.

NSW.title: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire
NSW.art: Star Wars - Shadows of the Empire (USA) (Rev B).webp
NSW.description: Third-person action game starring mercenary Dash Rendar. It mixed on-foot combat, vehicle sections (including the famous snowspeeder level), and Star Wars battles across multiple locations.

NSX.title: Supercross 2000
NSX.description: Supercross motorcycle racing with realistic tracks and career progression.

NSY.title: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
NSY.description: Licensed adventure following the Scooby-Doo gang through mystery-themed levels with exploration and light puzzles.

NSZ.title: NFL Blitz Special Edition
NSZ.description: Special edition package of the popular arcade football series.

NT2.title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
NT2.description: Sequel featuring expansive levels, alien threats, a powerful arsenal (including the iconic Cerebral Bore), and improved multiplayer.

NT4.title: CyberTiger
NT4.description: Golf game starring a cybernetic version of Tiger Woods on fantasy courses with power-ups and exaggerated physics.

NT9.title: Tigger's Honey Hunt
NT9.description: Platform adventure starring Tigger as he bounced through levels collecting honey pots.

NTA.title: Tarzan
NTA.description: Platform adventure based on the Disney film, featuring swinging, combat, and exploration as Tarzan.

NTE.title: 1080° Snowboarding
NTE.description: Nintendo’s stylish snowboarding title starring polar bear boarder Snowboarder and a cast of riders. It featured responsive analog-stick carving, big aerials, grabs, and a strong emphasis on chaining tricks for high scores. The tight controls, half-pipe mode, and sense of speed made it one of the best extreme-sports games on the system.

NTF.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
NTF.description: Revolutionary skateboarding game focused on building long trick combos, completing timed goals, and chasing high scores across compact skate parks. Its fluid controls and addictive career mode launched a massive franchise.

NTH.title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!
NTH.description: Platform adventure based on the film, starring Buzz Lightyear through colorful, toy-themed levels.

NTI.title: WWF Attitude
NTI.description: Sequel that expanded the roster, improved character creation, and added more match and career options.

NTJ.title: Tom and Jerry in Fists of Furry
NTJ.art: Tom and Jerry in Fists of Furry (USA).webp
NTJ.description: One-on-one fighting game starring Tom and Jerry (and other characters) with cartoonish combat and special moves.

NTK.title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
NTK.description: First-person shooter offering two playable protagonists, mission-based levels, and a new supernatural threat.

NTM.title: Mischief Makers
NTM.description: Platformer starring the robot girl Marina, who uses a unique grab-and-shake mechanic to defeat enemies and solve puzzles. Its tight controls and creative level design earned it a strong cult following.

NTN.title: All Star Tennis '99
NTN.description: Tennis game offering singles and doubles with a solid range of shots, court positioning, and tournament modes. It stood out for its responsive controls and multiplayer focus.

NTP.title: Tetrisphere
NTP.description: 3D puzzle game in which players cleared layers of a sphere by matching and removing Tetris-style pieces. Its unique presentation and depth set it apart from standard Tetris games.

NTQ.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
NTQ.description: Sequel that added manuals for even longer combos, expanded career goals, more creative levels, and a robust skatepark editor. Many consider it the peak of the early series.

NTT.title: Tonic Trouble
NTT.description: Platform adventure starring a clumsy alien who must clean up a spilled tonic that has mutated Earth’s creatures. It offered colorful levels and lighthearted gameplay.

NTU.title: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter
NTU.description: First-person shooter in which the warrior Turok explored dangerous jungles and ancient ruins while battling dinosaurs and other enemies. Its weapons and atmosphere helped define early N64 shooters.

NV3.title: Micro Machines 64 Turbo
NV3.description: Top-down racing with tiny vehicles on oversized household environments. The inventive track design and multiplayer chaos were its strengths.

NV8.title: Vigilante 8
NV8.description: Car-combat game set in an alternate 1970s, featuring armed vehicles, destructible environments, and story-driven missions. Its personality and multiplayer were highlights.

NVC.title: Virtual Chess 64
NVC.description: Digital chess game with competent AI and multiplayer support.

NVG.title: Vigilante 8: 2nd Offense
NVG.description: Sequel that added more vehicles, weapons, arenas, and continued the explosive car-combat action.

NVL.title: V-Rally: Edition '99
NVL.description: Rally racing featuring realistic tracks, weather, and car handling that emphasized simulation.

NVR.title: Virtual Pool 64
NVR.description: Pool and billiards simulation featuring realistic ball physics and multiple game modes.

NW2.title: WCW/nWo Revenge
NW2.description: Highly regarded wrestling game that improved on World Tour with a deeper roster, better grappling, championship paths, and excellent multiplayer. Many still consider it one of the best wrestling games of the era.

NW3.title: WCW Nitro
NW3.description: Wrestling game based on WCW television, featuring a roster of wrestlers and arcade-style matches.

NW4.title: WWF No Mercy
NW4.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest wrestling games ever made. It featured a deep roster, story paths, excellent create-a-wrestler tools, and flexible, timing-based grappling that rewarded skill. Its multiplayer and championship modes kept players coming back for years.

NW8.title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
NW8.description: Updated version of the arcade hockey game with refined features.

NWA.title: War Gods
NWA.description: One-on-one fighter featuring gods and mythical warriors with special moves and a dark aesthetic.

NWB.title: Iggy's Reckin' Balls
NWB.description: Puzzle-platformer in which players roll ball-shaped characters through obstacle courses and races, using momentum and unique abilities.

NWD.title: WinBack: Covert Operations
NWD.description: Tactical third-person shooter that emphasized cover-based firefights, peeking around corners, and special-forces missions. Its cover mechanics were influential.

NWF.title: Wheel of Fortune
NWF.description: Digital adaptation of the popular game show with solo and multiplayer modes.

NWG.title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey
NWG.description: Arcade-style ice hockey featuring fast action, big hits, and strong multiplayer that made it a popular early N64 sports title.

NWI.title: ECW Hardcore Revolution
NWI.description: Professional wrestling game based on Extreme Championship Wrestling, emphasizing hardcore matches and a roster of ECW performers.

NWL.title: Waialae Country Club: True Golf Classics
NWL.art: Waialae Country Club - True Golf Classics (USA).webp
NWL.description: Golf simulation set on the real Waialae Country Club course with a focus on realistic play.

NWM.title: WCW Mayhem
NWM.description: Wrestling game with WCW talent, multiple match types, backstage areas, and a career mode.

NWN.title: WCW vs. nWo: World Tour
NWN.art: WCW vs. nWo - World Tour (USA) (Rev A).webp
NWN.description: Wrestling game featuring WCW and nWo wrestlers with fast, arcade-style grappling and strong multiplayer.

NWO.title: World Driver Championship
NWO.description: Serious circuit-racing game with detailed tracks, car tuning, and simulation-oriented handling that appealed to racing purists.

NWP.title: Wipeout 64
NWP.description: Futuristic anti-gravity racing with weapons, tight tracks, and a strong sense of speed in the classic Wipeout style.

NWQ.title: Rally Challenge 2000
NWQ.description: Rally racing with dirt tracks, weather effects, and championship progression.

NWR.title: Wave Race 64
NWR.description: Watercraft racing game renowned for its realistic wave physics, buoy-based courses, responsive handling, and changing weather conditions. Its sense of riding on water was unmatched at the time.

NWS.title: International Superstar Soccer 98
NWS.description: Further refinement of the ISS formula that kept the series near the top of N64 sports games.

NWT.title: Wetrix
NWT.description: Puzzle game in which players built walls to contain water on a grid while preventing overflows and managing rising difficulty. Its unique concept made it memorable.

NWV.title: WCW Backstage Assault
NWV.description: Wrestling game that emphasized hardcore, backstage brawling over traditional ring matches.

NWW.title: WWF War Zone
NWW.description: Wrestling game featuring WWF superstars, signature moves, create-a-wrestler options, and multiple match types. It helped bring console wrestling into a new era.

NWX.title: WWF WrestleMania 2000
NWX.description: Wrestling game with a huge WWF roster, deep customization, championship modes, and accessible yet technical grappling. It set a new standard for the genre on N64.

NWZ.title: NBA In the Zone 2000
NWZ.description: Further iteration with roster and feature updates.

NX2.title: Gex 64: Enter the Gecko
NX2.description: Platform adventure starring the wisecracking gecko Gex as he travels through TV-themed worlds, using his tail and tongue in combat and traversal.

NX3.title: Gex 3: Deep Cover Gecko
NX3.description: Sequel that expanded Gex’s adventures with more levels, gadgets, and the same sarcastic personality.

NXF.title: Xena: Warrior Princess: The Talisman of Fate
NXF.art: Xena - Warrior Princess - The Talisman of Fate (USA).webp
NXF.description: Fighting game based on the TV series, featuring Xena, Gabrielle, and other characters with special moves and story-driven battles.

NXG.title: NBA Hangtime
NXG.description: Arcade basketball known for its high-flying dunks, create-a-player options, and four-player support.

NXO.title: Cruis'n Exotica
NXO.description: Arcade racer featuring exotic locations, stunt jumps, and unlockable vehicles in the accessible Cruis’n style.

NY2.title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
NY2.description: Polished 3D platform adventure in which Rayman traveled across imaginative worlds to defeat robotic pirates and free captured allies. Its level design, controls, and visual creativity made it one of the best platformers on the system.

NYP.title: Paperboy
NYP.description: Modernized version of the classic paper-delivery action game, complete with obstacles and targets along the route.

NYS.title: Yoshi's Story
NYS.description: Charming side-scrolling platformer in which a team of Yoshis traversed storybook levels, ate fruit to restore health, and searched for collectibles. Its art style, music, and gentle difficulty made it distinctive.

NYW.title: Harvest Moon 64
NYW.description: Farming and life simulation in which players restore a farm, raise animals, grow crops, build relationships with townspeople, and participate in festivals. Its relaxing pace and depth made it a beloved entry in the series.

NZO.title: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs
NZO.art: Battlezone - Rise of the Black Dogs (USA).webp
NZO.description: Hybrid first-person shooter and real-time strategy game featuring hover tanks. Players could jump between piloting a tank and commanding units from a strategic view, creating a unique blend of action and base-building.

NZS.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
NZS.art: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA).webp
NZS.description: Darker, more experimental Zelda adventure set in Termina. Link used a repeating three-day cycle, transformation masks, and careful time management to prevent the moon from destroying the world. Its atmosphere, side quests, and structure made it unique within the series.
